definitions.explanation: A polite way to ask about someone's identity.

examples.english: Who is it? / May I ask who you are?

examples.japanese: どなた⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦いらっしゃいます→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どなた⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
どなた⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is there anyone who understands Japanese?

examples.japanese: ⟦{先|さき}ほど→先ほど：04165_sakihodo⟧⟦お→お：03097_o⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦くださった→くださる：01305_kudasaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どなた⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Who was it that called earlier?

notes:
どなた is the polite equivalent of ⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧ (who). It belongs to the ko-so-a-do demonstrative system and is used when politeness or respect is required.

FORMALITY LEVELS:
- ⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧: casual/neutral
- どなた: polite
- ⟦どちら{様|さま}→どちら様：22795_dochirasama⟧: very polite/formal

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どなた⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: Who are you? / Who is it?
- どなた⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: someone (polite indefinite)
- どなた⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧: anyone at all (polite)
- どなた⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: Who might you be? (very polite)

USAGE:
- At the door: どなた⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (Who is it?)
- Introducing someone: ⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どなた⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (Who is this person?)
- Customer service: どなた⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (Who will be using this?)

Part of the ko-so-a-do system: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧・⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧・⟦あれ→あれ：00916_are⟧・⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧, ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧・⟦そこ→そこ：00991_soko⟧・⟦あそこ→あそこ：00919_asoko⟧・⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧, ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧・⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧・⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧・⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧, etc.
